scenes.heading: Pin your best-selling TikTok Shop videos

sents.d: Pin your best-selling TikTok Shop videos
Your pinned videos are the first thing new visitors see, so make them your best sellers.
People who like a video often check your profile next.
Proven sellers pinned at the top keep earning long after the feed moves on.
Check your sales data weekly and pin the three videos with the most orders.
Swap one out whenever a newer video sells better.

take: Pin your top sellers so every new profile visitor sees them first.
